title: Check Worthiness Estimetion of Text Data
summary: A research project classifying whether text claims (debate quotes and tweets) are worth fact-checking, using ensemble traditional ML models and resampling techniques to address severe class imbalance on the CLEF 2024 CheckThat! benchmark. SDV's CTGANSynthesizer is invoked to synthesize additional minority-class data, triggering a runtime performance warning about the resulting column expansion.
